mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the mean return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the unconditional mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the return distribution in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the mean return in high-housing periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 103.0, or the return distribution is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and triggers a forward-looking equity market sell-off over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflation that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger, or the joint signal does not produce a statistically significant negative return (interaction term p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a robust labor market that fuels wage growth and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 45% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression with interaction term).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 23770 billion dollars combined with rising residential construction signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 6-month moving averages, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
